text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Nnnrgh, daaaah!!!! Are you seriously 
telling me I lost here!? What the heck am 
I doing!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Seriously, what am I doing...? I'm 
supposed to be the strongest...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
choice_data_list:
...This loss will lead to the next 
victory.
I can't just let them look down on me.

I can't just let them look down on me, can 
I?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Shut up! You're a Trainer! Not a damn 
ethics teacher!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
What I want is a win! I don't need a 
single damn loss!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Give it to me! Tell me how to get 
stronger! ...I'll do whatever it takes...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It ended in a disappointing result, but... 
next time, she seems ready to cling to 
"victory" with even fiercer determination.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch...! If they lick me, I'll 
lick 'em right back! Like, totally slobber 
all over 'em... why you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few seconds later, Espoir City bit her 
tongue in frustration, but her fighting 
spirit showed no sign of wavering.
